exposure: Vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (V-NOTES) hysterectomy technique
outcome: conversion to laparotomy or conventional laparoscopy
cohort: The study included the first 139 patients who underwent V-NOTES hysterectomies performed by a single surgeon between 2021 and 2024.
finding: The study identified a four-phase learning curve for V-NOTES hysterectomy, with initial competency achieved after 12 cases and mastery reached after 53 cases.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section and the absence of vaginal delivery were identified as risk factors for bladder injury during V-NOTES hysterectomy.
